name: Qupa
tagline: The party quiz where phones are the buzzers.
summary: Scan a QR code on your Google TV, play on your phone. No app, no account.

highlights.label: JOIN
highlights.title: Scan, type a name, play
highlights.text: Up to 8 phones join by QR code in the browser. No install.

highlights.label: LOCAL
highlights.title: The TV is the server
highlights.text: The game runs on your home network, behind a room code.

highlights.label: REMOTE
highlights.title: No phones? Play in teams
highlights.text: Two to four teams take turns with the D-pad and OK.

highlights.label: QUESTIONS
highlights.title: 5,272 questions, 24 topics
highlights.text: From the Open Trivia Database, in English for now.

highlights.label: SPEED
highlights.title: Faster answers score more
highlights.text: Up to 1,000 points, never less than 500 for a right answer.

highlights.label: PRIVATE
highlights.title: No ads, no telemetry
highlights.text: No accounts and no outgoing network calls. UI in EN, ES, RU.

steps.title: Open Qupa
steps.text: Pick Play with phones on the TV.

steps.title: Scan the QR
steps.text: Phones join over your home Wi-Fi.

steps.title: Buzz in
steps.text: Answer on your phone; faster scores more.

steps.title: Podium
steps.text: Winner on screen, then play again.
